annotations.title: One hazard event for the map

description: One hazard event the interactive map opens when the reader taps a warning's area or a storm's cone: the event, or none when it is no longer listed. The map calls it in clients that display it; to list the hazards near a place, use get_hazards_near.

id.description: The event's id, as a warning's area on the map lists it
id.title: Id

name: get_map_event

MapEvent.description:
An event as the page draws it, from whichever read found it: a search near a place gives its
distance, a tapped warning read by its id gives none.

active_at.description: The latest moment the source reports it active
active_at.title: Active At

area.description: Whether the event covers an area (a warning's, a storm's cone)
area.title: Area

distance_km.description: From the place the map is of; none for a tapped event
distance_km.title: Distance Km

expires_at.description: When the source says it ends; null when it states none
expires_at.title: Expires At
